svg.text: The scope of the Agentic Primitives substrate
One anchor per agent. Nine offerings as packages. Three products and a kit on top. One ontology through everything; behaviour beside it, never authority.

g.text: ONTOLOGY — one vocabulary, bound by IRI, enforced by a build gate
T-box · SHACL shapes · vault-record bindings · PROV-O · on-chain term + shape registries
SKILLS CORPUS — behaviour authored and verifiable; grants nothing
archetypes · playbook contracts · domain libraries · Merkle log · assigned by digest

svg.text: admission — HTTPS required · mTLS optional · admission always
PRODUCTS — each in its own repository, importing published packages
code: the review loop on GitHub
import @agenticprimitives/* at exact, coherent versions — never a fork
RING 0 — 75 PACKAGES AS NINE OFFERINGS (an offering depends only on those below it)
readContract only · fail closed · ABIs and addresses ship in the same artifact
CHAIN — 43 contracts · Base Sepolia (public, verified) + the estate chain (mandate path)
AgentAccount + Factory (ERC-4337 / 7579 / 1271) · CustodyPolicy · DelegationManager + 8 caveat enforcers incl. DigestBinding + Payment · typed-name registries
ontology + shape registries · attestation · agreement · payment receipt · registry base · governance + timelock
Ring 0 = packages + contracts + ontology + Developer Kit (ADR-0063) · products in their own repositories · the skills corpus imports the packages, never the reverse
